title: authorization_details
description: The RFC 9396 authorization_details array of a consent request: exactly one typed object. A 1.1 receipt or request carries the 1.1 shape (`#/$defs/v1_1`) and a 1.0 one the 1.0 shape (`#/$defs/v1_0`); the receipt, signed-object and request schemas check a document that names its version against that branch only, so a 1.1 document cannot fall back to the single-transfer shape. This schema on its own accepts either shape: validate against `#/$defs/v1_1` to require 1.1.
